title: ContractTrace
description: Canonical JSON schema for one Soroban contract invocation trace: the ordered, correlated record that binds a contract function call, its typed arguments, its return value, the events it emitted, and (optionally) the raw result XDR. Each record is one JSON object emitted on a single NDJSON/JSONL line by the M1 extractor. trace_id is the cross-contract correlation key (the telemetry correlation id in docs/TELEMETRY_SCHEMA.md); event objects conform to schemas/events/event_envelope.schema.json and their topics are linked to the authoritative registry schemas/events/event-schema-registry.json. Bump `version` (and make it breaking) whenever a consuming decoder must change.

schema_version.description: Must equal the `version` of contract_trace.schema.json; a breaking schema change bumps both.

trace_id.description: 32-byte hex correlation key linking events spawned by the same invocation (and its nested cross-contract calls).

contract.description: Soroban contract id of the invoked contract (C-prefixed strkey form, or the raw 32-byte hex).

contract_name.description: Contract name as registered in schemas/events/event-schema-registry.json; used to link emitted events to the authoritative registry.

account.description: Source account that authorized the invocation (optional).

arguments.description: Ordered invocation arguments decoded per docs/SERIALIZATION_STANDARDS.md; each entry carries a typed value.

return_value.description: Function return value decoded per docs/SERIALIZATION_STANDARDS.md.

events.description: Ordered list of events emitted by this invocation. Each item is an event envelope (schemas/events/event_envelope.schema.json) plus the raw topic symbols and its 0-based emission order.

result_xdr.description: Optional base64-encoded raw result XDR (TransactionMeta) for auditability.

type.description: XDR type of the value (e.g. u32, i128, address, bytes, string, bool, vec, map, void).

value.description: Decoded value; `null` for void/nullable with no payload.

contract.description: Soroban contract id that emitted the event.

name.description: Event name; must exist in schema_version registry entry for the trace's contract_name.

version.description: Event schema version from the registry.

topics.description: Topic symbols (as extracted, e.g. ["record_created", "medical_records"]); every symbol must appear in the registry entry's topics list.

body.description: Event payload; validated against the registry event schema and, structurally, against schemas/events/event_envelope.schema.json.
